question: Which iconic Indian classical vocalist, often known as the "Mewati Maestro," is celebrated for his mastery of khayal singing and his innovative approach to ragas?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pandit Jasraj**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Pandit Jasraj, the legendary Indian classical vocalist, was often referred to as the "Mewati Maestro" for his contributions to the Mewati gharana.
 
• Pandit Jasraj was renowned for his exceptional command over the khayal form of singing.
 
• He innovatively incorporated elements of devotional music, particularly bhajans, into his performances.
 
• He was honored with numerous prestigious awards, including the Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Shri.
 
• **Mewati Gharana:**
 
 
• Founded by - Ustad Ghagge Nazir Khan
 
• Known for - Khayal singing
 
• Notable Exponent - Pandit Jasraj
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Khayal Singing:**

 
 
• A form of Hindustani classical music that emphasizes improvisation and the exploration of ragas.
 
• Typically performed with a slow tempo (vilambit) followed by a faster tempo (drut).
 
 
 
• **Raga:**
 
 
• A framework for improvisation akin to a melodic mode in Indian classical music.
 
• Each raga is associated with specific moods and times of the day or seasons.
 
 
 
• **Gharana:**
 
 
• A system of social organization linking musicians by lineage or apprenticeship, and by adherence to a particular musical style.
 
 
 
• **Pandit Jasraj:**
 
 
• Born - 28 January 1930
 
• Died - 17 August 2020
 
• Known for - His soulful and emotive style of singing
